verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is not a standalone product with its own interface. It is an Agent Skill (a SKILL.md folder) loaded into a host agent such as Claude, which 'turns Claude — or any agent that supports Agent Skills — into a disciplined identity designer.' The AI assistant you delegate to is the host platform, not something the skill embeds, so 'a built-in AI assistant inside the product' is a category error for an extension of this kind. Host-platform capabilities cannot be credited to it.
